description: Yield to conversion based on the ask price.
Yield to maturity calculated using the ask price; represents expected annualized return if purchased at the ask price and held to maturity
Yield to conversion based on the bid price.
Yield to maturity on the bid side, i.e., yield investors would earn if buying at bid price and holding to maturity
The nominal coupon rate specified for the bond, representing periodic interest paid
Type of bond maturity (e.g., bullet, fixed-term), categorizing how and when the bond principal is repaid
Code for frequency of coupon payments (e.g., annual, semiannual, quarterly)
Code indicating the coupon type (e.g., fixed, floating, step-up)
Current coupon rate applicable on the bond as of the date, especially relevant for floating or step-up coupons
Par amount or face value of the bond
Bid price, i.e., the price a buyer is willing to pay for the bond
Price at which the bond was originally issued
Day count convention code, specifying the interest accrual calculation method for coupon payments
Last traded price for the bond, typically representing the end-of-day closing price or last price observed
Bond's quoted ask (offer) price at the as-of date
Yield to conversion calculated using the average of bid and ask prices.
Mid price of the bond, either calculated or observed, typically midway between bid and ask prices
Yield to maturity calculated at the mid price for the bond as of the as-of-date
Minimum denomination or smallest tradable amount of the bond
Minimum trading increment, i.e., the smallest allowable amount by which the bond can be traded; expressed as a numerical value
Total amount of the bond issued at origination
The face value amount of the bond that is currently outstanding (not yet repaid) as of the date
Date when the bond or related event (such as issuance) was publicly announced
Date on which the bond matures, when principal is scheduled to be repaid
Redemption value, i.e., the amount paid upon maturity or call/redemption event of the bond
Trading volume (number/amount of bonds traded) for the bond at the as-of date
